claims: Love Overboard is a 2026 Hulu reality dating show.
Love Overboard is hosted by Bachelorette alum Gabby Windey.
Love Overboard features 22 singles aboard a luxury yacht in Malta.
Contestants on Love Overboard compete to live on the "Topside".
Winners on Love Overboard earn a $100,000 trip.
Love Overboard has executive production by Alex Cooper (Call Her Daddy).
Love Overboard has executive production by Jeff Jenkins.
Contestants on Love Overboard are split between luxury living and serving as crew.
"Shipwreckers" arrive to disrupt couples on Love Overboard.
Contestants on Love Overboard who fail to pair up "walk the plank" into the Mediterranean Sea.
All 9 episodes of the first season of Love Overboard are now streaming on Hulu.
